description: Ask Clerk to re-check a domain's DNS records now. Returns the same verification status as get_domain_status plus domain_id and last_run_at (epoch milliseconds of the last check). If a check is already running, returns status "in_progress" instead. Follow progress with get_domain_status.

domain.description: The domain's name, such as example.com, or its ID (dmn_…), as list_domains returns them.

name: check_domain_dns
title: Trigger a DNS check
